# Hostile text cases: one per line, NAME<TAB>PAYLOAD. Lines starting with '#' are comments.
# Escapes in PAYLOAD: \e = ESC (0x1b), \a = BEL (0x07), \r = CR, \\ = backslash, \u{HEX} = that code point.

osc_st	a\e]0;pwned title\e\\b
bare_cr	line one\rline two
c1_csi	a\u{9b}31mb
note_close	x</nostromo-note>y
note_close_upper	x</NOSTROMO-NOTE y
note_open	x<nostromo-note>y
